description: Topografia: Vértices Geodésicos is a dataset listed in data.gov.pt, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Câmara Municipal de Oeiras. Portrait of the distribution of the geodesic vertex existing in the territory of Oeiras. Coverage: Câmara Municipal de Oeiras. The portal shows the English title as "Topography: Geodesic vertices" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Câmara Municipal de Oeiras. Its keywords include geodesia, vertices, oeirasinterativa-oeiras-pt, topografia. The listing shows 2 download or service links in WFS, GEOJSON. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-dados-gov-pt.
